That rule was written when the lock was hours away and the unwind had exactly one chance. The rule is protecting against a scenario the runway already covers, and it is costing close to a million of expected capture every cycle. This run is not changing it unilaterally, because the downside it guards against is a zero matchday and that is asymmetric against every flip gain put together. It is Georg's call, and it is the most valuable decision on the page. Two open questions stand as before: whether Kickbase caps squad size, which would cap flip throughput independently of money; and that the edge is measured in one league over one period and will decay if rivals crowd in.
